title: shorea splendida
intro: Shorea splendida, commonly known as the "Red Meranti," is a species of tree in the family Dipterocarpaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects that aid in wound healing, and antifungal and antiviral properties that help combat infections. The bioactive constituents of Shorea splendida include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as reducing fever and relieving pain. The therapeutic actions of this plant also include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, making it a valuable resource for traditional medicine and potential applications in modern healthcare.
